text: DSH Web Search（DSH 网页客户端插件）：为 DSH 接入统一网页搜索，可并发查询多个后端并合并去重结果。支持 Exa、Parallel、DuckDuckGo、SearXNG 等免密来源，也可配置凭证启用其他服务；另有筛选、排序、复杂查询融合、缓存和历史记录。适合需要在 DSH 中搜索并汇总网页资料的用户。默认免密后端无需凭证。

DSH Web Search adds unified web search to DSH. It queries multiple backends concurrently and merges duplicate results. Keyless sources include Exa, Parallel, DuckDuckGo, and SearXNG; credentials enable other providers. It also offers filters, reranking, query fusion, caching, and history.

DSH Web Search 的功能「多源网页搜索」：通过 DSH web 搜索接口并发查询已启用且可用的后端，收集有效网页来源；单个后端失败时仍可保留其他后端结果。
DSH Web Search 的功能「复杂查询融合」：启用多查询后，对较长或含比较分隔词的查询派生最多两个子查询，并用 RRF 融合原查询与子查询结果。
DSH Web Search 的功能「搜索缓存与历史」：搜索结果可写入本地缓存，历史记录可在设置开启时追加；插件还注册历史查询和清空接口。

Zero-config search out of the box (Exa + Parallel + DuckDuckGo + SearXNG are keyless); API-key backends (DeepSeek / Anthropic / OpenAI / Brave / Tavily / Serper / Mojeek) auto-activate once their key is supplied via the credentials service or env.

@240xu/dsh-websearch README · Design | 设计：- **One provider, no ambiguity**: a single `registeredSearchProvider({id:"unified"})` — the `dsh-web` seam's selection rule picks it unambiguously, and `search()` caps `maxResults` itself.
- **`Promise.allSettled` fan-out**: every enabled + available backend fires concurrently; a single backend failure is demoted to a soft `null` so the rest still contribute — only when ALL fail does the provider throw `WEB_PROVIDER_ERROR`.
- **Per-backend abort demotion**: a single backend aborting becomes soft-null; the provider only rethrows `WEB_ABORTED` when the caller's own `AbortSignal` fires.
- **Dedup strategies**: `url` keeps the historical URL-key merge with cross-backend field fill-in; `url+title` additionally collapses same-story syndicated mirrors (title Jaccard >= 0.9, CJK-aware tokenizer) while still enriching the kept entry.
- **Deterministic rerank (optional)**: query-term overlap scoring (title x3 / snippet x2 / URL x1); stable ties preserve fan-out priority — same input always yields the same order.
- **Honest timeouts**: each backend runs under an internal abort controller merged into the caller signal; when only the internal timer fire
